heading: Our suite of game development technologies
text2: KeyDevs Technologies has a large pool of developers and artists who build games on the leading engines and platforms.

items.title: Unity Game Development
items.text: Unity is the engine behind a large share of mobile games. Our Unity developers build 2D and 3D games that run smoothly on every major platform from a single project.

items.title: iOS Game Development
items.text: Swift and Unity-based pipelines let us build iPhone and iPad games that make the most of Apple hardware and services.

items.title: Android Game Development
items.text: We build Android games with Unity and native tooling, tuned for a wide range of devices and screen sizes.

items.title: AR Game Development
items.text: ARCore and ARKit-powered games that place characters and worlds in the player’s real surroundings.

items.title: VR Game Development
items.text: Immersive virtual reality games for Oculus, Google VR and mixed reality headsets.

items.title: Mixed Reality
items.text: Mixed reality experiences that blend digital objects with the physical world for play, training and visualization.
